Priya: Quick thread 00: NovaBank InfoSec sent a vendor risk questionnaire and asked for DPA confirmation, SCCs, BYOK options, DSAR process, and log retention. Who can own what? @Dan @Mateo

Dan: Ill take the SIG/CAIQ pack and the questionnaire technical answers. I need the canonical CAIQ export.

Mateo: I exported a CAIQ CSV last week and added short plain-English notes. Uploading PDF to: https://redwood.atl/vrm/novabank-ca iq.pdf now.

Claire: Legal note: we act as a processor. We will sign our standard DPA and the EU SCCs. For retention choices we need to document options and responsibilities in an appendix.

Raj (NovaBank): For the POC we will send tokenized PANs and require 60-90 day trace logs + a clear deletion path. Also confirm whether BYOK is an option for the POC.

Dan: BYOK is supported on Private (HSM) and Dedicated via cloud KMS integration. Hosted uses our managed keys unless the customer requests a dedicated key config (paid).

Mateo: Default log retention: 30 days, PII redaction enabled by default. We can offer 90-day retention as an add-on for Hosted/Dedicated or configure it on Private.

Priya: Can we support 90 days for the POC without a lengthy compliance review?

Claire: 90-day retention is operationally allowed on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted we treat extended retention as a controlled add-on; Legal wants the appendix and a checkbox in the SOW. We can turn it on for a timeboxed POC with signed DPA.

Mateo: Redaction snippet for sales blurb: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=30 OR 90 (add-on); PII_REDACTION=true; REDACTION_PATTERNS=regex:(PAN|email|ssn); CACHE_PREFIXING=disabled_for_sensitive_inputs.

Raj (NovaBank): We also have to demonstrate DSAR handling and deletion. What is the SLA?

Claire: Hosted: we provide deletion APIs and pursue completion within ~30 days. Dedicated/Private: we provide runbook + tooling; customers typically execute deletion but we can assist under support scope. We'll include a DSAR runbook in the POC bundle.

Dan: Action items: Ill attach CAIQ PDF + short Q&A sheet. Mateo: include exact redaction rules and note cache recommendations. Claire: draft DPA + retention appendix and flag subprocessors. Priya: add line item for extended retention to the POC quote.

Priya: Thanks 00. Raj, can you confirm InfoSec window for the questionnaire?

Raj (NovaBank): They plan to review us next Tuesday. Need docs tonight or tomorrow morning. We need DPA signed before ingesting tokens.

Priya: Got it 00. We will push CAIQ PDF and DPA draft to you by EOD. :thumbsup:
